parsed.internal_thinking: I have won the game with 5 victory points. I secured Longest Road and reached the point threshold. I should acknowledge the win and the competitive play from Bob and Charlie, especially considering the history with Bob's betrayal and Charlie's warnings.
parsed.note_to_self: I won this one by focusing on the road while Charlie was hunting for knights. Keeping that ore blocked really made the difference in slowing him down.
parsed.say_outloud: That was a close one! Charlie, you had me sweating with those knights, I really thought you were going to pull it off. Bob, sorry about the port blocking, but I couldn't risk you getting that engine running after last time! Good game, both of you.
